jobs.description:
Are you looking for a stable job in a high-tech production environment where quality, innovation, and teamwork are at the heart of everything? We are recruiting a Production Operator/Production Worker for a leading company specializing in the packaging of nuts. You'll play a key role in maintaining an efficient production process while ensuring the highest quality standards.

Whether you're just starting your career or already have experience in manufacturing, we offer comprehensive training, ongoing support, and opportunities for career growth. As a Production Operator, you will work in a modern packaging facility equipped with advanced machinery, ensuring production runs smoothly and products meet our quality expectations.

Your Responsibilities

• Set up, operate, and adjust automated packaging and packing machines.

• Monitor product quality and ensure all packaged products meet company standards.

• Troubleshoot minor technical issues and perform basic maintenance tasks.

• Contribute to efficient production planning and continuous process improvement.

• Work closely with fellow operators and team leaders to achieve production targets.

• Maintain a clean, safe, and organized workplace in accordance with hygiene and safety regulations.

• You have initial experience working in a production or manufacturing environment, preferably within the fruit and vegetable industry.

• You have a good command of both Dutch and English.

• You have an affinity for technology and production processes.

• You are detail-oriented and committed to delivering high-quality work.

• You are a team player with a hands-on mentality.

• You are flexible and willing to work in shifts when required.

For a food production company, we are looking for motivated flexi workers who can work either a few hours per day or a full day shift.

Your responsibilities

 
• 
Supporting production and packaging activities.

 
• 
Performing repetitive tasks while following quality standards.

 
• 
Working accurately and hygienically in a food production environment.

 
• 
Profile

  
   
• 
You are comfortable working in a cold environment.

   
• 
You have no objection to the presence of pork products.

   
• 
Repetitive work does not discourage you.

   
• 
You have no physical complaints or limitations.

   
• 
You are available during weekdays (1 to 2 days per week is sufficient).

   
• 
You speak Dutch, French, or English.

  
Working hours

  
   
• 
You can work a few hours per day or a full day shift.

   
• 
Monday to Thursday: 7:30 AM – 5:00 PM.

   
• 
From October onwards: fixed early shift or fixed late shift.

Tasks & Responsibilities
 

 
• Monitor supplier compliance with the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR).
 
• Track project progress and ensure deadlines are met.
 
• Organize and facilitate online meetings with suppliers.
 
• Explain PPWR requirements, compliance expectations, and supplier responsibilities.
 
• Discuss and clarify different packaging types and packaging processes.
 
• Coordinate implementation plans and define target dates.
 
• Follow up on corrective actions and ensure timely execution.
 
• Monitor progress, milestones, and supplier commitments.
 
• Prepare weekly compliance reports for management.
 
• Identify risks, bottlenecks, and areas requiring escalation.
 
• Conduct audits and inspections within warehouse operations.
 
• Verify manufacturer labels and packaging compliance.
 
• Ensure packaging and labeling processes meet PPWR requirements and internal standards.
 
• Collaborate with internal departments and external suppliers.
 
• Contribute to a sustainable, compliant, and efficient supply chain.
 
• Support continuous improvement initiatives and process optimization projects. 

Profile
 

 
• Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
 
• Experience with sustainable packaging solutions is an asset.
 
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
 
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and SharePoint.
 
• Knowledge of Access and Power BI is a plus.
 
• Able to manage multiple suppliers, projects, and deadlines simultaneously.
 
• Strong planning, organizational, and prioritization skills.
 
• Accurate, structured, and detail-oriented.
 
• Able to work independently while maintaining a proactive approach.
 
• Analytical and capable of making fact-based decisions.
 
• Strong follow-up skills and a results-driven mindset.
 
• Positive attitude combined with a strong work ethic.
 
• Team player who values collaboration and respect.
 
• Eager to learn and continuously improve processes.

jobs.occupation: Multi-skilled maintenance technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers
You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the greater area of Oostkamp
Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not required, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC...

jobs.occupation: Sales Operations Manager | Brecht | Vast Contract
jobs.description:
Sales operations manager

Are you an experienced people manager who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-paced operational environment? Do you combine strong leadership skills with a hands-on approach to order management, backlog management and customer service?

For an international and dynamic organization, I am looking for a Sales Operations Manager to lead a team of four employees.

In this role, you will be close to both the people and the operation. You will coach and develop your team, set priorities, monitor performance and ensure that customers and internal stakeholders receive clear and timely follow-up.

Your responsibilities 

 
• Lead, organize, motivate and coach a team of 4 employees on a daily basis. 
 
• Oversee order and backlog management and ensure customer service enquiries are handled efficiently. 
 
• Set priorities and distribute the workload evenly across the team. 
 
• Monitor team performance, operational metrics and KPIs, and take action where needed. 
 
• Identify training and development needs and provide ongoing coaching. 
 
• Conduct regular one-to-one meetings and performance evaluations. 
 
• Listen to team members' feedback and support them in resolving challenges or conflicts. 
 
• Create sufficient space for team members to contribute to improvement projects alongside their daily responsibilities. 
 
• Work closely with internal stakeholders to resolve escalations and ensure clear communication regarding priorities, progress and expected deliverables. 
 
• Provide management with feedback on operational challenges and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. 
 
• Contribute to a positive and collaborative working environment and organize team-building activities. 

Who are we looking for?

For this position, I am looking for someone who knows how to lead and develop people while maintaining a strong overview of the operational priorities. 

 
• You have several years of experience in a leadership or coordinating position, ideally within sales operations, order management or customer service. 
 
• You have proven people management experience and enjoy coaching, motivating and developing team members. 
 
• You have experience with backlog management and are strong at setting priorities and maintaining overview. 
 
• You are an excellent coordinator and communicator who can effectively manage expectations with different stakeholders. 
 
• You are comfortable monitoring KPIs and using them to drive team performance. 
 
• You have strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 
• You remain calm and effective in a dynamic environment and know how to manage competing priorities. 
 
• You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively. 
 
• You have solid computer skills, including experience with Microsoft Office, CRM systems and SAP. 
 
• You are fluent in English. Additional languages are an asset, but not a requirement. 
 
• Experience with data modelling and data management tools is considered an advantage.

Location : Belgium

Start date : ASAP

Duration : 3 - 6 months + extension(s)
Senior IT Project Manager - workforce management application

We are looking for a Senior IT Project Manager to lead a Workforce Management project, covering the analysis of RFP responses and the implementation of an application delivered by an external supplier.

The solution will support employee scheduling, working time management and employee evaluations.

You will coordinate HR stakeholders, IT teams, Procurement and external partners throughout supplier evaluation, implementation and rollout. Knowledge of HR processes and experience delivering a similar project are highly desirable.
Description

• 
RFP analysis & supplier evaluation: Analyse supplier proposals against business and technical requirements, compare implementation approaches, identify gaps and risks, and support supplier selection.

• 
Project management: Lead the full project lifecycle, managing scope, planning, budget, resources, quality and change.

• 
Business & IT coordination: Work with HR stakeholders, Business Analysts and technical teams to clarify requirements and ensure the solution meets business needs.

• 
Supplier management: Coordinate the selected supplier's activities, monitor commitments and deliverables, and manage dependencies with internal teams.

• 
Application implementation: Oversee configuration, integrations, data migration and deployment of the supplier-delivered application.

• 
Testing & UAT: Coordinate testing and user acceptance with HR and business teams, ensuring issues are addressed before go-live.

• 
Reporting & governance: Prepare weekly status reports, Steering Committee presentations and PMO updates, following established project management standards.

• 
Risk & issue management: Identify risks, track mitigation actions and resolve or escalate issues.

• 
Change & rollout: Coordinate communication, training, business readiness and transition to operational support.

• 
Team leadership: Functionally manage up to five team members, including Business Analysts, developers and testers.

Required skills:

• 
At least 5 years of experience in IT project management in a business or industry environment

• 
Proven experience implementing business applications delivered by external suppliers

• 
Experience analysing RFP responses, evaluating supplier proposals and supporting solution selection

• 
Strong supplier management and coordination skills

• 
PMP, Prince2 or equivalent project management certification

• 
Strong stakeholder management, communication and executive reporting skills

• 
Experience managing budgets, planning, risks and project dependencies

• 
Ability to lead projects independently and coordinate business and technical teams

 

Preferred experience:

• 
Previous implementation of a Workforce Management solution or a similar HR application

• 
Knowledge of HR processes, particularly workforce planning, employee scheduling, time and attendance, and employee evaluations

• 
Experience with application integrations and data migration

• 
SAP knowledge is a strong plus

• 
A retail/Supply background is an asset

 

Education & languages:

• 
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or equivalent

• 
Good understanding of current and emerging technologies

• 
Native French or Dutch required, combined with Fluent English

The role

• Negotiate with clients and candidates

Who are we looking for?

Experienced Recruiters who want more commercial ownership, earning potential and career progression.

Sales Professionals with a strong background in B2B Sales, business development or account management who want to build a career in recruitment.

• Holding a Bachelor's or Master's degree

 

We care more about your ability to build relationships, win business and deliver results than your job title.

We are looking for an experienced IT Business Analyst to support the development and optimization of IT applications used to manage fibre network infrastructure.

You will act as the bridge between business stakeholders, end-users and IT development teams, ensuring business requirements are translated into effective IT solutions.
Key responsibilities

• 
Gather, analyze and translate business needs into functional IT requirements.

• 
Organize workshops and align expectations between business stakeholders and IT teams.

• 
Review and validate functional analyses and coordinate IT development follow-up.

• 
Prepare and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and support application releases.

• 
Coordinate change management, end-user training and communication activities.

• 
Provide functional support, investigate application issues and follow up on incident resolution.

• 
Ensure data quality and contribute to continuous application improvements.

• 
Work with GIS-based fibre inventory systems supporting FTTH, Fttc and backbone infrastructure.

Ideal candidate

A proactive, analytical and results-oriented Business Analyst who can combine detailed functional analysis with a broader understanding of IT systems and business processes. You are comfortable coordinating multiple stakeholders and supporting IT projects from requirements gathering through implementation and operational support.

• 
Proven experience as an IT Business Analyst or Functional Analyst.

• 
Strong requirements gathering, functional analysis and stakeholder-management skills.

• 
Experience with UAT, application implementation and change management.

• 
Ability to facilitate workshops and manage conflicting stakeholder requirements.

• 
Understanding of IT applications, system integrations and data models.

• 
Knowledge of SQL, MSA or ERD data models is an advantage.

• 
Experience with GIS applications or telecommunications infrastructure is an advantage.

• 
Strong analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills.

• 
Ability to work independently in a complex IT environment.

• 
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; master's degree preferred.

• 
Languages

• 

• 
Dutch: Fluent

• 
French: Fluent

• 
English: Fluent

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment.
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with business analysts and software developers for our equipment integration solution. You will be supported by dedicated test engineers. 

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates. 

• You perform the crucial task of analyzing how our equipment integration software platform can implement business requirements. The specifications to be passed on to internal and more often external developers can range from straightforward configuration to additional logic to be defined. 

• Some business requirements will result in equipment integration being dependent on related configuration or even features to be implemented in adjacent applications, especially the MES. You thus will gain sufficient knowledge about adjacent CIM applications to effectively collaborate with their business analysts and functional analysts. 

• You have an active role in test preparation and debugging. You will be supported by our PMO team during all phases of the software lifecycle. 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a master’s degree in engineering, exact sciences, or equal by experience. 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in a complex manufacturing environment, characterized by demanding processes, high product mix, and delicate materials. 

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab. 

• You have participated in a CIM project, understanding concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS. 

• You have strong analytical skills and are solution oriented. You can challenge assumptions and question approaches. 

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are dependable. 

• You feel comfortable in a complex environment. 

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

jobs.occupation: Test Analyst | Manual Testing | API Testing | Postman | Diegem | Hybrid
jobs.description:
Opportunity

Ensure the quality and reliability of our Defense Platform which offers a complete in-service support lifecycle for materials, consumables, and repairable items within defense organizations.
You focus on validating Enterprise Suite functionalities, testing APIs, and ensuring that systems behave as expected in environments where quality and reliability matter.

Meaningful Work in a Mission Driven Environment
Your work supports applications used in operational environments. You ensure that functionality, integrations, and business processes are reliable, consistent, and ready to support users and operational activities.

The Impact You Help Create
You improve application quality, reduce risk, and ensure that business-critical systems perform reliably. Your work supports consistent and trustworthy outcomes.

Your Mission

What you will do:

• Design, execute, and maintain detailed test plans and test cases covering functional and non-functional testing
• Perform API testing
• Perform integration, regression, and end-to-end testing activities
• Identify, document, and track defects
• Support test documentation and reporting
• Work with development teams to resolve issues and improve quality
• Contribute to structured testing processes and continuous improvement
• Support automated testing activities

What You Bring

• Experience in manual and functional testing
• Strong experience with API testing
• Proven experience using Postman
• Understanding of testing methodologies (ISTQB foundation level or similar knowledge)
• Experience with test and defect management tools such as Jira, Spira, Xray, or similar
• Knowledge of test automation tools such as Playwright or equivalent
• Analytical mindset and attention to detail
• Strong communication skills in English
• Ability to work independently and within a team

Systems Thinking and Analytical Strength
You understand how business processes, application functionality, APIs, and system behavior connect. You analyze outcomes and ensure that applications perform consistently across scenarios.

Working Across Teams and Functions
You work with developers, analysts, and others stakeholders. You support collaboration and ensure that quality is maintained across the development process.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment. 
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with equipment engineers and software developers.  

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates.  

• You will follow Fab Operations to understand the different levels of automation currently implemented in our cleanrooms.  

• Your initial task will be the verification of equipment to host communication as specified during purchasing. Semiconductor equipment communication follows a comprehensive set of standards. However, these standards allow for differences in implementation and scope definition which often cause complications with equipment integration.  

• Once more experienced, you will play a decisive role in exploring equipment behavior at the communication interfaces under different operational scenarios.  

• Your test results are not just necessary for bug fixing. They are crucial input for equipment integration developers in the first place.  

• You will contribute to improving our test methodology, utilizing dedicated test software as well as equipment simulators. 

Who you are
 
 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in software development and testing, specifically related to hardware automation.  

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab.  

• You did apply concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS. You understand the difference between instructions and reports. You know how to analyze data exchange with hardware units and debug communication issues.  

• You have strong analytical skills, are self-critical, and solution oriented.  

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are persistent.  

• Prior experience in a cooperative setup, original software supplier's engineers sharing the workload with in-house developers, as well as onsite-remote hybrid collaboration, is highly desired.  

• You feel comfortable in a complex environment.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

Responsibilities

• Design pragmatic and sustainable end-to-end solutions that align with business requirements and IT architecture standards.
• Translate complex business needs into robust technical specifications and architectural designs.
• Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to foster consensus and drive alignment from project inception to production.
• Define short, medium, and long-term visions for IT system development within a hybrid environment of legacy and modern technologies.
• Present architectural solutions to the governance board and maintain high-quality documentation.
• Validate solutions with technical teams while considering implementation costs and long-term maintainability.

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience in solution architecture and functional design.
• You possess deep knowledge of Domain Driven Design (DDD) concepts and asynchronous integration patterns.
• You have experience navigating hybrid IT landscapes, specifically transitioning from legacy environments to modern stacks.
• You're proactive, creative, and capable of synthesizing large amounts of complex information.
• You are fluent in English with fluency in either Dutch or French and at least basic knowledge of the other.
Nice to Haves

• Experience in the life insurance sector.
• Knowledge of ArchiMate for architectural modeling.
• Familiarity with .NET, Angular, or COBOL environments.
• Willingness to explore and implement technological innovations in critical systems.

Opportunity

This is an office-based role. Candidates are expected to work from our office at least 4 days per week. Remote work is limited to 1 day per week.

Building reliable infrastructure from the inside

Reliable infrastructure is about more than keeping systems running. It means understanding how an environment works, solving problems at their source and creating systems that become easier to manage over time.
As a System Engineer at ILIAS Solutions, you take ownership of the infrastructure behind our international organization. This is an internal IT position: you will not work directly with customers, but you will support the people who build, deliver, implement and support the ILIAS Defense Platform.
You work across Linux systems, hybrid infrastructure and automation. Alongside day-to-day operations, you look for patterns: where recurring work can be automated, where configurations can become more consistent and where better documentation can make the environment easier to understand. The goal is clear: continue moving infrastructure from reactive support towards a structured, automated and predictable engineering environment.

Meaningful work

ILIAS develops software for demanding defense and security environments, and the people behind that work depend on reliable technology every day. As part of Internal IT, your impact is internal but reaches across the organization: you help create the technical foundation that enables development teams to build, implementation teams to deliver and support teams to help customers. When infrastructure is stable, secure and well managed, colleagues across Belgium, the Netherlands, Denmark and the United States can work with fewer disruptions and greater confidence.

Your Mission

What will you do?

• Manage and improve the internal server infrastructure that supports ILIAS employees across offices, teams and business functions.
• Take ownership of Linux system administration, including installation, configuration, maintenance, troubleshooting, patching and performance follow-up.
• Use Ansible to automate recurring work, standardize configurations and make infrastructure changes repeatable, traceable and less dependent on manual execution.
• Maintain Linux and Windows Server environments across VMware, Azure and on-premises infrastructure.
• Investigate complex infrastructure, system, software and network issues with an analytical mindset and a focus on sustainable solutions, not quick fixes only.
• Contribute to clear documentation, monitoring, backup routines, operational procedures and continuous improvement of internal IT processes.
• Support secure and reliable access to the internal systems and infrastructure services used by ILIAS colleagues every day.
• Work with the reliability, quality and security awareness expected from a company active in the defence domain and certified according to ISO 9001 and Cyber Essentials.
 

What you bring?

• Proven experience as a Linux System Administrator or System Engineer.
• Strong hands-on expertise in Linux server environments. Linux is not a side topic in this role; it is one of the core areas where we need depth.
• Solid experience with Ansible, including playbooks, automation and configuration management.
• Good knowledge of Azure and experience with cloud or hybrid infrastructure environments.
• Knowledge of VMware and Windows Server environments.
• A security-minded approach to infrastructure and operations.
• Strong analytical thinking skills: you can investigate issues thoroughly, identify root causes and explain your reasoning clearly.
• A predictable and transparent way of working: you document what you do, communicate clearly and keep colleagues informed before, during and after changes.
• The maturity to take ownership, challenge unclear requests, ask the right questions and work towards sustainable improvements.
• A degree in IT, Computer Science or equivalent experience.
• At least C1 level in Dutch and English.

Responsibilities

• Map current operational processes and design future-state operating models across multiple entities.
• Draft and maintain comprehensive functional specification dossiers to drive application migrations.
